## findings
1. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — F1 (XF 11). Symptom: P1 usage_trend tiers = mean monthly net vends over 1/2/3 months × 12/52; P2 visit_gap tiers = 1 day / 30÷completed / 7 days / 30÷scheduled. Root cause: method label on window-length / divisor / constant swaps. Evidence: `_difficulty.md` §findings F1; vmi.extended.yaml P1 rule "its weekly usage is its net vends of the latest month times 12 divided by 52 … half of its net vends of the latest and the middle month together, times 12, divided by 52 … net vends of the last three months divided by 13"; P2 rule visit-gap sentence. Consequence on this world: P1 and P2 have no surviving method factor (P1: 5 parameter; P2: 5 parameter), below the floor of 1. Affected: vmi_ext_vended_item_fill_level.factors, vmi_ext_consigned_reorder_point.factors (and their rule sentences). New in revision_1.
2. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — F2. Symptom: P1 restock_cover tier "20 or more visits … 18 or more scheduled visits" unreachable (Onsite visits are onsite_daily). Consequence: P1's ladder has two reachable tiers; Onsite Storeroom gets 2 weeks vs Twice-Weekly 1 week. This world sits on the 1-week tier, so the factor bears weight here, but the ladder is not real. Affected: P1 rule restock-cover sentence and compute restock_cover. New.
3. SOURCE-POLICY RED — F7. Symptom/evidence: submit_vended_item_bin_request_0334ff8e docstring "with a reorder point of 0 that stays at 0 until Corbett records its own reorder point entry for the bin" (and "quote afterwards"). Consequence: the hop P3→P2 ("not placed until … a reorder point above zero" → Corbett's reorder-point entry) is announced by the tool handed over at step 15. Affected: task_tools.py P1 docstring. New.
4. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — PT-1, PT-2 (proof text). Evidence above; affected: tasks/0.json computations[2].factor_trace[0], computations[0].factor_trace[0], design_rationale FACTOR CARD. New.
5. Observations: O1 (thin seed: 3 bins on a Twice-Weekly program, no replenishment or monthly-minimum rows), O2, O4, O10 (order lines SO-4413870 / SO-4414112 booked at 6.85 on 2026-03-24 / 03-30, before the contract line's 2026-04-20 effective date — booked price is an estimate under order_evt_booking_and_shipping, no shipped line), O12.
